title: TENDER FOR THE SUPPLY AND/OR SUPPLY, INSTALLATION & MAINTENANCE OF SIGNAGE ACROSS HAMPSHIRE UNDER A FRAMEWORK AGREEMENT
description:
Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council (the council) are seeking to commission competent and experienced contractor(s) for the provision of signage at various site locations throughout Hampshire. The Council is acting as Lead Authority on behalf of the authorities listed below:  \r
â€¢	Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council\r
â€¢	East Hampshire District Council\r
â€¢	Eastleigh Borough Council\r
â€¢	Fareham Borough Council\r
â€¢	Gosport Borough Council\r
â€¢	Hampshire County Council\r
â€¢	Hart District Council\r
â€¢	Havant Borough Council\r
â€¢	Isle of Wight Council\r
â€¢	New Forest Borough Council\r
â€¢	Portsmouth City Council\r
â€¢	Rushmoor Borough Council\r
â€¢	Southampton City Council\r
â€¢	Test Valley Borough Council\r
â€¢	Winchester City Council\r
\r
Other authorities that are part of this process comprise:\r
\r
â€¢	Town and Parish Councils within Hampshire\r
â€¢	Junior, Primary and Secondary Schools in the Hampshire County Council local authority area, (private schools are not included in the Framework).\r
\r
The main objective of this invitation to Tender(ITT) is to establish a Framework Contract, potentially with multiple suppliers (however, only 1 supplier will be awarded to each of the four lots which could potentially be the same supplier) to cover the needs of each organisation that uses the framework.\r
\r
The framework will  cover the supply of various types of signage, ranging from very small quantities (one item) to larger orders.  As requirements differ for each organisation, the contract will comprise of 'supply only' and/or 'supply and installation' Lots.  \r
\r
The framework will be split into four Lots as detailed below:\r
\r
Lot 1 	Street Name Plates	Supply Only\r
Lot 2	Street Name Plates	Supply and Installation/maintenance\r
Lot 3	Road Signage (including Directional Signs, Information signs)	Supply Only\r
Lot 4 	Road Signage (including Directional Signs, Information signs)	Supply and Installation/maintenance\r
\r
The Councils intents to award only one supplier to each Lot, however, tenderers can bid for one or more Lots; though each Lot will be evaluated separately and response documents must be provided for each lot that the tenderer is responding to. Therefore, the potential successful tenderer could be appointed to more than one lot.\r

title: Professional Consultancy Services for the Enterprise M3 Local Enterprise
description:
This is award notice is published on behalf of The Enterprise M3 Local Enterprise Partnership.

Enterprise M3 Local Enterprise Partnership's are appointing a Professional Consultancy Services for the Enterprise M3 Local Enterprise Partnership's multi-site Enterprise Zone, in Hampshire and Surrey & have been supplied with the attached documents.

Enterprise M3 Local Enterprise Partnership (LEP) established a multi-site Enterprise Zone in April 2017 seeking to deliver 10,000 jobs and support 131 businesses. The Zone relates to three sites covering around 40 hectares in Hampshire and Surrey: 

i.	'Basing View' in Basingstoke, Hampshire; 
ii.	'Longcross Park' in Chertsey, Surrey and, 
iii.	Whitehill & Bordon in Hampshire. 

An initial 5-year Implementation Plan was developed and undertaken between 2017- 2022. Over £24 million of investment has delivered new infrastructure and enabled site development at each of the three Zone sites. With the completion of this initial investment period, Enterprise M3 LEP is seeking to commission multi-disciplinary consultancy support that will take the zone to the next stage of delivery and support partners in maximising the jobs, economic growth and business rates retained income over the remaining 20 years of EZ status.

The objective of the commission is to provide information and documentation that will inform and support the development of the second Implementation Plan that reflects the long-term objectives for the three sites, the key partners and the LEP.

This information will provide an evidence base for additional investment required across the multi-site Enterprise Zone. 

Since the information and Implementation Plan will be jointly owned by all parties engaged in this programme (Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council, East Hampshire District Council and Runnymede Borough Council) it will be essential for the Service Provider to engage fully with these parties throughout the contract period.

title: ​​PCI_Lot_A_097​ ​​Whitehill and Bordon Transport Strategy​
description:
A call-off from ​Lot A​ of the Place, Connectivity & Infrastructure Professional Services Framework 2022-2026 (Published 4 March 2022). 

 

To develop a draft updated Transport Strategy for the area of Whitehill and Bordon due to the extensive redevelopment in the area. • apply the principles and policies of the Hampshire Local Transport Plan (LTP4) • inform the priorities for the spend of the remaining s106 linked to the development The draft Transport Strategy will cover the whole area of Whitehill and Bordon and will take account of the views of local stakeholders, members, the developers and East Hampshire district council. It will identify local transport-related issues and problems and consider how these should be addressed. Work to develop the draft strategy and action plan will build upon existing work undertaken by Hampshire County Council, Whitehill & Bordon regeneration company and East Hants District Council, including their work on potential interventions. Council and WSP staff will work closely together throughout the project to share information and insight and to explore emerging ideas so that the resulting strategy follows good practice and reflects client expectations.

title: Lot 27 East Hampshire Younger Adults Supported Accommodation
description:
This contract will cover Younger Adults Supported Accommodation Services commissioned by Hampshire County Council. 

Younger Adults Supported Accommodation will have care and support attached to particular property.  This could be from a few hours a week to 24/7 support with a team of support staff. 

This Contract is initially for a capacity of 12 individuals.  The services are provided to 8 individuals in a block of 8 flats.  There are an additional 4 service users currently living in sole occupancy properties.  

There is likely to be future expansion of the Service if there is a requirement to support other individuals other properties in Hampshire. The Support Provider will be expected to work with the Council to help create Services that meet the needs of other individuals whose primary needs may fall within any of the client groups listed below. 

Client Groups 

The Client Groups that are eligible for these Services: 

People with a Learning Disability 

People with a Physical Disability/Sensory Impairment 

People with an enduring Mental Health condition 

People with Autism or Asperger's Syndrome 

At the point of tendering, the individuals identified have a learning disability.

The total value of the tender is worth up to £16,050,000 for up to 10 years, this includes the possibility of an expansion opportunity.  

The initial core service is worth up to £9,167,783 for up to 10 years. 

There may be scope for service expansion that will include another property(ies) and additional service users, worth up to £3,670,868 for up to 10 years. 

Awarded Value £8,427,648.60

title: Pungo - Joy - WorkWell
description:
NHS Frimley ICB sought to commission a digital software application tool which supports the function of Social Prescribing across 4 Places -Bracknell Forest, North East Hampshire and Farnham, Surrey Heath and The Royal Borough of Windsor and Maidenhead, as well as secondary care partners (including adult social care, outpatients, and voluntary sector community connectors). 

The purpose and aim of this procurement was to source a software solution that will connect participants to local services that can support their journey back into or to remain in work, effectively reducing pressures on Primary Care Services through the repetition of issuing fit notes and avoidable GP appointments. 

The system requires the need to work, and be integrated, with EMIS and SystmOne, creating a streamlined referral process which will improve coordination between different providers.

The Commissioner is directly awarding a contract to Pungo Ltd (Joy Social Prescribing Digital Solution) in accordance with the G-Cloud 14 (RM1557.14) guidance. The total value of the initial 1 year contract term is £122,285.58 (exc VAT). The contract includes  an optional extension of one period of up to 12 months. The total value of the optional 12-month extension period is £122,285.58 (exc VAT) plus an increase by the greater of: (i) the percentage increase in the Retail Prices Index (all items) published by the UK Office for National Statistics in the preceding 12-month period; or (ii) 2% (two per cent.). 

The initial 1-year contract period commenced on the 1st May 2025. 

This procurement has been carried out by NHS South, Central and West Commissioning Support Unit (SCW) on behalf of the Commissioners.
